correctness.rationale: The stationary convolution splits independent Gaussian thermal and active terms, giving exact thermal-insensitivity for distinct axes. Conditioning on a shared backward Poisson gap sequence and independent isotropic orientations gives Cov(X_i²,X_j²)=v^4/d²(Cov(Z_a,Z_b)-2 E W/(d+2)). Renewal identities reduce these to rational functions with the displayed P and positive Q. Independent symbolic algebra verified the closed positive Cov(Z_a,Z_b), and exact rational tests in 324 parameter combinations verified P/Q. For d<=4 all coefficients are negative; for d>=5 Descartes sign count has one change and endpoint signs give a unique root. P is affine and increasing in p=ab at the equal-rate root, yielding the sharp anisotropy penalty. Thermal noises and singular tumble endpoints are not misrepresented.

evidence: Sun et al. provide a Volterra moment recursion for isotropic harmonics; Guéneau et al. provide full stationary joint laws in isotropic d-dimensional traps.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Broad moment coverage in the isotropic setting does not dominate the anisotropic pairwise invariant; a general anisotropic hidden appendix would be a priority risk but was not identified.

value.rationale: The shared-clock positive energy fluctuation competes with the negative uniform-sphere fourth cumulant, producing a dimension-dependent sign boundary. Exact critical dimension, uniqueness and anisotropy shift are natural interpretable cross-axis statistics not supplied by isotropic radial moments.

final_claim: For stationary isotropically redrawn run-and-tumble orientations in d>=2 and positive diagonal trap rates a,b on distinct axes, the squared-coordinate covariance equals 2 v^4 P_d,a,b(gamma)/[d^2(d+2)Q_a,b(gamma)], independent of axiswise thermal noise. It is negative at all positive gamma for d<=4 and has a unique sign-reversing positive rate for d>=5 with sharp lower bound 3(a+b)/(d-4), equality only at a=b.
